# fael.tech

> Personal site of Rafael (Fael) Goulart, a software engineer specialized in UX and, more
> recently, AI. He co-founded two companies and was CTO of Aurum Software. fael.tech is where he
> studies, builds, and publishes, and the name he uses for independent work. It is also the home
> of the fael.tech brand visual identity. Static site, no build step, bilingual (pt-BR / en).

## Pages

- [Home (pt-BR)](https://fael.tech/index.html): who Fael is, why fael.tech exists, what he is
  building now (Longward, AIKM, Radiant), and consulting/partnership contact.
- [Home (en)](https://fael.tech/en/index.html): English version of the above.
- [Studies (pt-BR)](https://fael.tech/estudos/index.html): index of studies - the story of
  fael.tech, AIKM (local knowledge manager for AI work), and Radiant (method for building software
  with agents).
- [Studies (en)](https://fael.tech/en/studies/index.html): English version of the above.
- [Longward (pt-BR)](https://fael.tech/longward.html): thesis of Longward, the company Fael is
  founding - collective continuity, the role of AI, the four questions an idea must pass, and how
  its products will be built.
- [Longward (en)](https://fael.tech/en/longward.html): English version of the above.
- [Career (pt-BR)](https://fael.tech/sobre.html): profile, full experience timeline, education,
  MIT certification, and languages.
- [Career (en)](https://fael.tech/en/career.html): English version of the above.
- [Contact (pt-BR)](https://fael.tech/contato.html): consulting and partnership areas, email,
  LinkedIn, GitHub, and location.
- [Contact (en)](https://fael.tech/en/contact.html): English version of the above.

## Docs for AI agents / LLMs

- [docs/ai/overview.md](./docs/ai/overview.md): purpose, structure, tone-of-voice guidance.
- [docs/ai/facts.md](./docs/ai/facts.md): canonical career/bio facts - single source of truth for
  numbers, dates, education, and certification.
- [docs/ai/content-map.md](./docs/ai/content-map.md): page-by-page purpose and key claims.

## Notes

- Career growth figures for Aurum are confirmed in [docs/ai/facts.md](./docs/ai/facts.md). Company
  results (revenue, user base) are context for the period, not attributed to Fael.
- `brand/` is the single source of truth for brand visual assets (symbol SVGs,
  `tokens.css`, the original printable manual) - not a source for biographical facts.
